M-LINT-CORE.Summary: Core lint orchestration: project load, graph/verification cross-checks, markup link validation.

M-LINT-TYPES.Summary: Shared lint result and issue record types, including absence classification.

M-LINT-CATALOG.Summary: Lint issue catalog: titles, remediations, and absence-code justification fields.

M-ASSERTIONS.Summary: Plan assertion evaluation and absence primitives used by status and gates.

M-PROJECT-UTILS.Summary: Governed-file discovery, markup scanning, and language-analysis routing for absence codes.

M-GRAMMAR.Summary: XML artifact grammar validation for context, graph, verification, and change bundles.

M-STATUS.Summary: CLI status surface: durable health, change lifecycle, and next-action derivation.

M-DOCTOR.Summary: CLI doctor surface: adapters, coverage, optional context gaps, and absence-by-reason report.

M-SKILLS.Summary: Canonical GRACE skill sources under skills/ngrace/ (packaged mirror is separate).

M-CURSOR.Summary: Run ledger and cursor write surface: show, regenerate, advance, pause, resume, fold.

M-ARTIFACT-TYPES.Summary: Shared artifact grammar constants: root tags, companion registry, anchor patterns.

M-CLI.Summary: CLI entry point registering ngrace subcommands.

M-GATES.Summary: Transition gate surface: approve, apply, archive evaluation and ledger decisions.

M-REVIEW.Summary: Review surface: process audits, pattern detectors, and review.* findings.

M-LOCALIZE.Summary: Failure localization: marker divergence comparison and verification localize CLI.

M-QUERY.Summary: Artifact query and navigation: module, file, graph, and verification resolution.

M-CLI-INFRA.Summary: Shared CLI infrastructure: GraceCommandError, error envelope, runGraceCommand, and defineGraceCommand (boolean space-form guard).

M-CONTEXT.Summary: Context selection surface: task slices, skill subsetting, and selectedBytes measurement.

M-TEST-SUPPORT.Summary: Test fixtures, defect corpus, and token-accounting helpers for the suite.

M-CALIBRATION.Summary: Calibration report: claimedConfidence vs independent target-assertions adjudicators; context class derived at fold; never gate-consumed.
